name: Portrait of an Old Woman
summary: Unknown artist, Portrait of an Anonymous Woman, 1675-1725, ink and colour on silk. This portrait would have been one of a pair, hung to the left of a portrait of her husband during the ceremony of ancestral worship. It shows an anonymous woman in Manchu dress. She is wearing a black cap with a pearl

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
